pick off-bottom, stand down at 821m, the string started to vibrate and then started to rotate backwards consistent with boulder trapping the bit. The pumps were turned down to 500lpm and the string pulled up and free with 25tons overpull. The flow was brought up to drilling rate and rotation established and the bottom single reamed to ensure the well was clear. The connection was made and normal drilling resumed. Aft
